title: Small Compiler Subset BSBC Artifact Round Trip
purpose: Prove that a real BSBC artifact emitted by the independent compiler driver can be persisted, reloaded later by the independent loader, executed by the independent BSharp VM, and reproduce the exact in-memory result.
required_proofs: saved artifact bytes equal independent in-memory bytes
repeated artifact compilation is byte-for-byte deterministic
artifact execution equals fresh in-memory independent execution
artifact execution equals production BSharp VM referee execution
artifact execution equals Ruby Runtime referee semantics
source file is not required after successful artifact creation
failed source compilation cannot overwrite an existing accepted artifact
